title: Paris and Amsterdam Explorer

gallery.alt: Paris rooftops with the Eiffel Tower in the distance
Seine river cruise boat passing Notre-Dame
High-speed train at Gare du Nord

overview: Two of Europe's best-loved cities in one trip. Spend four nights in Paris with the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre and a Seine cruise, then take the high-speed train to Amsterdam for three nights of canals, museums and a day in the Dutch countryside. We handle your Schengen visa application from start to finish.
